Pool: the US severe and moderate haemophilia A patients prophylaxis is given to, 8,011 + 3,319 = 11,330 in federally funded treatment centres over 2012 to 2018 (Soucie JM et al., Haemophilia 2020, PMC8117262, Table 2). Shares 3.1%, 12.5% and 20.8%. Fitted through the engine's identity at 1.55% discontinuation (curve on the midpoint row): a peak of 0.096939 of the unswitched pool a year. MULTIPLE 0.5, A JUDGEMENT: 0.5 x 0.096939 = 0.04847. For more: superiority on fAAT against weekly pdAAT, every three weeks instead of weekly, recombinant supply free of plasma, and the first new AAT product since 1987. Against: approval on a serum biomarker with no lung density or outcome data, no plasma franchise of Sanofi's own to switch from (part of ALTUVIIIO's uptake was its own Eloctate), entrenched home-infusion services behind weekly pdAAT, and a price not yet set. On this path the stock is 11% of the pool in year 2 and 42% in year 10
